catalysts.headline: Q3 2026: revenue $45.8M (-62.8% YoY) missing ~$74.2M consensus; gross margin collapsed to 5.2% from 37.6% (incl. a $9.3M inventory write-down); net loss $76.8M incl. $35.7M impairment; cash $124.4M vs $196M of debt due within 12 months (incl. $41.7M convertible bonds due Jan 31, 2027); company disclosed substantial doubt about its ability to continue as a going concern
catalysts.impact: Stock reportedly fell ~48.5% the following session (not independently re-confirmed)

catalysts.headline: Microvast reports Q3 2026 results: revenue $45.8M (-62.8% YoY), net loss $76.8M (vs -$1.5M a year earlier), including a $35.7M non-cash impairment charge; non-GAAP adjusted EBITDA -$60.8M (vs +$21.9M a year earlier)
catalysts.impact: Sharp deterioration from a 62.2% YoY drop in sales volume (189.6 MWh vs 501.7 MWh); management said it has 'limited visibility' into revenue for the next several quarters and has stopped reporting its order backlog.

catalysts.headline: Microvast Q3 2026 results (reported after market close): revenue $45.8M, down 62.8% YoY from $123.3M, missing consensus of ~$74.2M; volume fell ~62% to 190 MWh on weaker heavy-duty truck, port equipment and mining equipment demand in Europe and APAC plus industry pricing pressure; gross margin collapsed to 5.2% from 37.6% a year earlier, with a $9.3M inventory write-down accounting for ~20 points of the decline; non-GAAP adjusted net loss of $76.0M vs. an adjusted profit of $11.9M in Q3 2025; a $35.7M long-lived asset impairment was recorded; cash, cash equivalents and restricted cash of $124.4M as of Sept 30, 2026 versus $196M of debt obligations maturing within 12 months (including $41.7M of convertible bonds due Jan 31, 2027); CEO Yang Wu said the sharp drop in sales and margins has significantly constrained liquidity; company disclosed substantial doubt about its ability to continue as a going concern
catalysts.impact: task-stated session move of approximately -48.5%; exact percentage not independently re-confirmed from a live quote in this session

catalysts.headline: Microvast reported Q3 2026 results after market close 2026-11-09; pre-report consensus (Earnings Whispers, 2026-11-02) had been ~$74.2M revenue vs. $87.3M in Q2 2026. Actual reported figures not independently located this session -- stock's -48.5% premarket move on 2026-11-11 is reported as tied to a miss, per aggregator coverage, not yet confirmed against the primary release.

conflicts: MVST price: a Yahoo Finance Canada listing shows a $0.7951 close on 2026-11-13, up ~340% -- this conflicts with Benzinga ($0.22, Nov 10) and MEXC ($0.22, Nov 14) and looks like a data error; not used.
notes: Q3 2026 release (already on file as lastCat) included a going-concern warning alongside the revenue miss (finviz: 'revenue collapses 63% and going concern warning turns the story from growth to survival'); management says it is negotiating with lenders to refinance/extend/restructure near-term debt. Microvast also has until 2026-02-22 to regain Nasdaq minimum-bid-price compliance per an earlier Nasdaq notice (exact notice date not pinned down this pass, so not listed as a dated catalyst). No reverse split found; the large price move is attributable to the earnings reaction, not a split.
